proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 14 Safe points daily upon log-in (~100 to 200 free FLUX.1-schnell or SDXL images generated daily).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides high-speed, stable OpenAI-compatible API endpoints for open-source models like FLUX.1-schnell, SD3, and Stable Diffusion XL without cold starts or IP blocks from GitHub Actions.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Replace the broken Pollinations/Horde image generation step in 'produce_coloring_book' and 'produce_kdp_cover' pipelines.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Registration requires phone verification; documentation is occasionally translated from Chinese but API standard is strictly OpenAI-compliant.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to upload unlimited 3D models. Standard marketplace fee on sales (no monthly listing cost).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Fastest growing 3D search engine and marketplace for STL/3D files. Features a highly active community of 3D printing enthusiasts looking for functional/parametric models.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Target platform for 'produce_stl_parametric' pipeline. Run python scripts in GitHub Actions to output STL files, then manually or semi-automatically upload to Thangs.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Heavy focus on 3D printable models; purely artistic models perform worse than functional or pop-culture/tabletop gaming assets.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Free to set up a publisher account. No listing fees. Takes commission on sales (30% to 35% standard).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: The absolute gold standard marketplace for tabletop RPGs, map packs, paper minis, and rulebooks. Customers are highly accustomed to buying PDFs and digital-only print-and-play assets.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Target platform for 'produce_card_game' and 'produce_coloring_book' (re-packaged as RPG fantasy maps or dungeon tiles).
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Strict formatting rules for PDF uploads; community is highly sensitive to low-quality AI art, requiring careful curation of outputs.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: 2,000 requests per day for search and download of audio files.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Provides programmatically searchable access to millions of user-submitted sound effects, many under CC0 (Creative Commons Zero) or Public Domain licenses.
proposals.would_integrate_where: A new pipeline 'produce_gamedev_audio_pack'. Query CC0 UI sounds, ambient loops, or retro laser effects, bundle them with Python's pydub library, and sell them as asset packs on itch.io or Unity Asset Store.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Must strictly filter search results to 'license:"Creative Commons 0"' to ensure complete legality for commercial resale.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Completely free, no registration required for standard read requests. Rate limit is based on polite user-agent header.
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: Unlocks millions of high-resolution, public-domain historical illustrations, botanical drawings, and vintage maps perfect for commercial reconstruction.
proposals.would_integrate_where: Integration into 'produce_cultural_arbitrage' or 'produce_svg_pack'. Automatic downloading of vintage line drawings, vectorizing via potrace in GitHub Actions, and uploading to Redbubble or Etsy.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires robust metadata parsing to confirm the source file is strictly 'PD-Old' or 'CC0' and not restricted by country-specific copyright laws.

proposals.free_tier_concrete_limits: Generous free signup credits (often $10 to $20) with ultra-low PAYG pricing (~$0.0015 per FLUX.1-schnell image).
proposals.what_it_does_uniquely: An enterprise-grade cloud provider serving open-source AI models at near-cost prices. Highly reliable endpoint availability with zero rate-limit blocks for GitHub Actions.
proposals.would_integrate_where: High-quality, reliable backup to 'together_ai' and 'cloudflare' in the image generation stack.
proposals.risk_or_caveat: Requires credit card verification on signup to prevent abuse, even when using free trial credits.
